title: Heat Pumps Explained — And Tested | Guy Martin
summary: UK documentary explains air-source heat pumps, follows one from factory to a commissioned home install, and covers running cost versus gas, grants, installation quality and noise.

assertions.quote: We put in one unit of electricity and we get four units of heat out, so they're 400% efficient.
Trouble is, electric's four times the price of gas, so it's all meeting the middle.
running a heat pump could cut a home's CO2 emissions
is one of the reasons heat pumps are more expensive than [music] normal boilers.
Heat pumps incredibly unforgiving. They need to be commissioned correctly.
costs around 11,000 pounds. With a grant of 7 and 1/2 thousand pounds

verdicts.note: The £7,500 grant covers roughly half to two-thirds of typical UK air-source installation costs.
MCS data put the average UK air-source installation at £12,713 after the grant rose to £7,500, so the grant covered about 59% and left about £5,213 to the household.
